approval.prompt: Original image-to-3D concept for faceted waterfront FPS. Single coherent isolated game prop centered on plain light grey background, full object visible in three-quarter front view. Clean broad triangulated flat-shaded geometry, one solid colour per material, no grain, dirt, outlines, drawn seams, logos, text, people, floor or surrounding scenery. Believable construction, strong readable silhouette. A compact original green-grocer produce display stand: three broad stepped wooden crates in one waist-height rack, loosely grouped chunky faceted golden squash, muted green cabbages and brown potatoes. Walnut structure, graphite base. Width1.6m height1.15m depth0.6m.
